source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed advertised specifications in a consumer product performance report

1. Start with the test records.
2.
completion:
Prepare a table that contains all of the test records where the customer complained about that IT product that is being advertised and all test records where your team noticed that the IT product does not perform as it is being advertised.
3. Summarize the advertising in a way that illuminates the relationship between the advertising and performance issues.
4. Create a table of the test records and summarize the test records to summarize every way that IT product fails to perform as advertised.

## 1. Start with the test records.
All of the data that is collected by the lab in the course of developing your consumer product performance report, is test data.
It is the lab's job to test the advertisement on the device.
At the end of each recording session it is the job of the lab or the lab manager to write a test record.
We have templates where the lab or lab manager fills in blanks in a template with the data that was collected
